method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 9 of 15 breaks heard

lines.english: let dreams be put to flight,
from on high Jesus shines forth.

lines.latin: Mens jam resúrgat tórpida, Non ámplius jacens humi:
lines.english: Let the sluggish mind now rise, no longer lying on the ground;
to take away all that harms.

lines.latin: En Agnus ad nos míttitur Laxáre gratis débitum:
lines.english: Lo, the Lamb is sent to us to loose our debt freely;

lines.latin: Omnes simul cum lácrimis Precémur indulgéntiam.
lines.english: let us all together with tears pray for pardon,

lines.latin: Ut cum secúndo fúlserit, Metúque mundum cínxerit,
lines.english: that when He shines forth a second time and girds the world with fear,
He may not punish us for our guilt,
but in His mercy then protect us.

lines.latin: Virtus, honor, laus, glória Deo Patri cum Fílio,
lines.english: Power, honour, praise and glory to God the Father with the Son,
